symptom: expected E9 near branch, got EB short branch
resolution: Use the tested JMP_NEAR macro. TASM may shorten JMP NEAR PTR and pad with NOP.
Check the first earlier extent change and remove compiler prologue or accidental alignment.

symptom: fixup site, target, frame, addend or ordering differs
resolution: Keep EXTRN in the intended segment; preserve DGROUP framing and ORG emission order. Runtime's current oracle requires zero fixups.
Use the TASM-native runtime source. Turbo C inline ASM can alter compiler register preservation.

symptom: queue or receipt does not describe current construction inputs
resolution: Refresh unedited source before claiming work. After an edit use FAST and promotion; never reuse old success.

symptom: source outside the candidate range changed
resolution: Restore unrelated changes and restrict transcription to this card's source lines.

symptom: exact bytes but unresolved bytes did not decrease
resolution: Replace unresolved emissions with symbolic instructions or supervisor-evidenced typed data; do not reclassify DB by comments.

symptom: Expected 8B /r absolute memory load, got B8+register immediate load; module shrinks
resolution: Use an explicit segment for a numeric address: mov di,word ptr ds:[0c0e4h]. Bare numeric brackets are not enough in TASM 1.0.
